title: PowerBridge EL keyword signature record
description: One line of pl_transpiler/tools/pl_signatures.jsonl. kind, arg_types, max_arity, verification and verified_by are generated by tools/gen_catalog_fields.py.

kind.description: syntax: a language/reserved word or filler word (If, Then, Begin, Shares, Ago); builtin: everything else.

max_arity.description: Largest argument count PowerBridge itself defines (semantic/codegen arity tables, codegen lowerings, live runtime signatures); null where PowerBridge does not define one.

verification.description: verified:capture-strategy: used by a strategy whose per-bar outputs (required columns) match a MultiCharts capture in tests/verify_all.py (captures not public; check skips in a clone). verified:test: EL embedded in a PowerBridge test calls it. documented-unverified: no evidence. n/a: syntax words, where verification does not apply.
